# SaltWatch Card 0.5.7

This patch fixes the metric divider in narrow details-only cards.

## What changed

- When the two metrics stack vertically, the divider now switches to a full-width horizontal line.
- Side-by-side metrics keep their vertical divider, including short compact cards.
- Responsive regression coverage now checks both natural-height and fixed-height stacked layouts.

## Compatibility

- Existing card configurations continue to work without changes.
- No dashboard YAML changes are required.
- The emulator and SaltWatch firmware are unaffected.

## Validation

- 49 unit tests passed.
- 45 browser tests passed across desktop and mobile profiles; one desktop-only mobile-scroll test was skipped as intended.
- The production TypeScript and Vite build passed.
